import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

def main():
    X = load_digits().data.astype(float)
    n, d = X.shape

    # 中心化
    mean = X.mean(axis=0)
    Xc = X - mean

    # 共變異數矩陣（分母 n-1）
    C = (Xc.T @ Xc) / (n - 1)

    # np.linalg.eigh
    w, V = np.linalg.eigh(C)

    # 排序（降序）
    order = np.argsort(w)[::-1]
    w = w[order]
    V = V[:, order]

    k = 10
    components = V[:, :k].T          # (k, d)
    explained_variance = w[:k]       # eigenvalues
    explained_variance_ratio = w[:k] / w.sum()
    X_pca = Xc @ V[:, :k]           # scores (n, k)

    # 對照組：sklearn PCA
    pca = PCA(n_components=k)
    X_ref = pca.fit_transform(X)

    # 對齊符號（eigh 的 eigenvector 符號不定）
    for i in range(k):
        if np.dot(components[i], pca.components_[i]) < 0:
            components[i] = -components[i]
            X_pca[:, i] = -X_pca[:, i]

    # 重建
    X_recon = X_pca @ components + mean
    X_ref_recon = pca.inverse_transform(X_ref)

    # 檢查項目：(名稱, 實際最大差, 容差)
    checks = [
        ("explained_variance (eigenvalues) max|diff|", np.max(np.abs(explained_variance - pca.explained_variance_)), 1e-8),
        ("explained_variance_ratio max|diff|", np.max(np.abs(explained_variance_ratio - pca.explained_variance_ratio_)), 1e-8),
        ("components max|diff| (sign aligned)", np.max(np.abs(components - pca.components_)), 1e-6),
        ("transformed scores max|diff| (sign aligned)", np.max(np.abs(X_pca - X_ref)), 1e-6),
        ("reconstruction max|diff|", np.max(np.abs(X_recon - X_ref_recon)), 1e-6),
        ("orthogonality max|C C^T - I|", np.max(np.abs(components @ components.T - np.eye(k))), 1e-10),
        ("score mean max|.|", np.max(np.abs(X_pca.mean(axis=0))), 1e-10),
    ]

    print("PCA 手刻 vs sklearn.PCA 對照檢查")
    print(f"資料: digits, X shape={X.shape}, k={k}, n={n}")
    print("-" * 70)
    all_ok = True
    for name, actual, tol in checks:
        ok = bool(actual <= tol)
        all_ok = all_ok and ok
        print(f"{name:45s} actual={actual:.3e}  tol={tol:.0e}  {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
    print("-" * 70)
    print("ALL PASS" if all_ok else "SOME FAIL")

    # 額外印出前 10 eigenvalues
    print("\n前 10 eigenvalues:")
    for i, v in enumerate(explained_variance, 1):
        print(f"  PC{i:2d}: {v:.6f}  ratio={explained_variance_ratio[i-1]:.6f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

BUGS = ["none", "ratio_topk", "denom_n", "no_center", "rows"]
TOLS = [1e-8, 1e-8, 1e-6, 1e-6, 1e-6, 1e-10, 1e-10]
CHECK_NAMES = [
    "explained_variance (eig) max|diff|",
    "explained_variance_ratio max|diff|",
    "components max|diff| (sign aligned)",
    "transformed scores max|diff| (sign aligned)",
    "reconstruction max|diff|",
    "orthogonality max|C C^T - I|",
    "score mean max|.|",
]

def run_pca(X, bug):
    n, d = X.shape
    if bug == "no_center":
        mean = np.zeros(d)
        Xc = X.copy()
    else:
        mean = X.mean(axis=0)
        Xc = X - mean

    denom = n if bug == "denom_n" else (n - 1)
    C = (Xc.T @ Xc) / denom

    w, V = np.linalg.eigh(C)
    order = np.argsort(w)[::-1]
    w = w[order]
    V = V[:, order]

    k = 10
    if bug == "rows":
        components = V[:k, :].copy()
        explained_variance = w[:k].copy()
        X_pca = Xc @ components.T
    else:
        components = V[:, :k].T.copy()
        explained_variance = w[:k].copy()
        X_pca = Xc @ V[:, :k]

    if bug == "ratio_topk":
        explained_variance_ratio = explained_variance / explained_variance.sum()
    else:
        explained_variance_ratio = explained_variance / w.sum()

    # reference (always sklearn PCA)
    pca = PCA(n_components=k)
    X_ref = pca.fit_transform(X)

    # sign alignment
    for i in range(k):
        if np.dot(components[i], pca.components_[i]) < 0:
            components[i] = -components[i]
            X_pca[:, i] = -X_pca[:, i]

    X_recon = X_pca @ components + mean
    X_ref_recon = pca.inverse_transform(X_ref)

    actuals = [
        np.max(np.abs(explained_variance - pca.explained_variance_)),
        np.max(np.abs(explained_variance_ratio - pca.explained_variance_ratio_)),
        np.max(np.abs(components - pca.components_)),
        np.max(np.abs(X_pca - X_ref)),
        np.max(np.abs(X_recon - X_ref_recon)),
        np.max(np.abs(components @ components.T - np.eye(k))),
        np.max(np.abs(X_pca.mean(axis=0))),
    ]
    return actuals

def main():
    X = load_digits().data.astype(float)
    k = 10
    results = {bug: run_pca(X, bug) for bug in BUGS}

    # table: rows = checks, cols = bugs
    colw = 17
    header = f"{'check':45s}" + "".join(f"{b:>{colw}s}" for b in BUGS)
    print("PCA 檢查 × 錯誤 表（每格：實際值 PASS/FAIL）")
    print(f"資料: digits, X shape={X.shape}, k={k}")
    print("-" * (45 + colw * len(BUGS)))
    print(header)
    print("-" * (45 + colw * len(BUGS)))
    for ci, name in enumerate(CHECK_NAMES):
        row = f"{name:45s}"
        for bug in BUGS:
            a = results[bug][ci]
            tol = TOLS[ci]
            pf = "PASS" if a <= tol else "FAIL"
            cell = f"{a:.2e}{pf[0]}"
            row += f"{cell:>{colw}s}"
        print(row)
    print("-" * (45 + colw * len(BUGS)))
    print("圖例: 格內 '...e-xxP' = PASS, '...e-xxF' = FAIL")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
